snippet.title: Inside The Forest : Release Trailer
snippet.description:
You and a group of friends decide to go on a camping trip in the Darkwood Forest, It starts off smoothly, but unforeseen events occur. and it’s only a matter of time before the true horror reveals itself.

PLAY NOW ON STEAM: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3363820/Inside_The_Forest

Alternatively you can purchase on Itch.io
https://stepan-tsokur.itch.io/inside-the-forest

#horror #gamedev #psychologicalhorror
